mechanism_and_quality_notes: Shared tenant shelves expose movable boundaries; independent hot-key and request-priority controls govern storage. Selected data replicates separately from nearby caches; a storage-origin change feed invalidates cache entries. Rust proxy is a request layer, and capacity limits qualify placement. No all-data replication or replica-to-cache chain.
